en.headline: Water supply resumes in Shau Kei Wan and parts of Sai Wan Ho from 9.30pm
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department said emergency repairs to the damaged main on Shau Kei Wan Road were completed, with supply returning progressively from 9.30pm on Tuesday.
body: The Water Supplies Department said fresh water supply to Shau Kei Wan and parts of Sai Wan Ho began returning progressively from 9.30pm on Tuesday after emergency repairs to a damaged main on Shau Kei Wan Road were completed.

According to the department, some users at the end of the pipe network or at higher elevations may take three to four hours for water to reach them. Temporary supply points with water trucks and tanks will continue until normal supply is fully restored.

The department noted that water may appear milky or slightly cloudy at first because of air in the pipes. Users were advised to remove the faucet strainer, run the tap for several minutes until the water clears, and reinstall the strainer, or to let water stand in a container until bubbles dissipate.

The Highways Department said it apologised for the inconvenience caused by the road works that damaged the pipe and would investigate the incident thoroughly. The outage had affected about 10,000 households and businesses since mid-morning.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣及部分西灣河食水供應晚上九時半起陸續恢復
zh.dek: 水務署表示，筱箕灣道受損食水管的緊急維修工程已完成，周二晚上九時半起供水陸續恢復正常。
body: 水務署表示，經工程團隊搶修，筱箕灣道因道路維修工程意外受損的食水管已完成修復，筱箕灣及部分西灣河用戶的食水供應於周二晚上九時半起陸續恢復正常。
署方指出，由於供水管網龐大複雜，實際恢復時間會因地勢、位置、管道情況及樓層而有所不同。按過往經驗，位於管網末端或地勢較高的用戶可能需三至四小時才有供水。臨時供水點的水車及水箱會繼續運作，直至供應完全恢復。
水務署提醒，恢復初期食水可能含有較多空氣而呈奶白色或稍為混濁，屬正常現象。建議用戶先移除水龍頭隔篩，持續開啟數分鐘待水質清澈後再裝回，或讓食水在容器中靜置待氣泡消散。
路政署就事件造成的不便致歉，並表示會全面檢查相關工程及調查事故責任。今早起約一萬戶受影響的停水情況至此告一段落。
